name: bergbot-around
title_zh: 任意坐标起算的徒步路线筛选器
tagline_zh: 村口、缆车站、木屋、峰顶、GPX 起点——只要给个点，它按实时路况排出值得走的路线，不用先查「附近有什么山」。
tagline_en: Give it a village, lift, hut, summit, or GPX start — it ranks real hikes by current conditions, no need to know.
desc_en: Find suitable hikes around any place — village, address, stop, lift station, hut, summit, coordinates or a GPX start — ranked by conditions. Use for "hike near/around X".
why_zh: 不是按行政区划搜「某地徒步」，而是以你给的任意地理坐标为圆心算可达性，连缆车站和 GPX 起点都认。
why_en: It doesn't search by region name — it computes from your exact point (even a lift or GPX start) and ranks by trail conditions.
limit_zh: 只认欧洲阿尔卑斯及周边路网数据源；给非洲或亚洲坐标会直接报错。路线排序依赖天气与积雪实时接口，离线时只给静态列表。
limit_en: Only covers Alpine & nearby European trail data; non-European coords error out. Live condition ranking needs internet; offline gives static list only.
title_en: Hike finder from any point, ranked by conditions
